events.label: First death
events.description: A clear game death or defeat screen is visible, with explicit on-screen death or defeat evidence. This is a suggestion for the operator to confirm. Low health, a menu, loading or an ambiguous animation does not establish death.

events.label: Victory screen
events.description: A clear victory or completion screen is visible, with explicit victory evidence. This is a suggestion for the operator to confirm. Celebratory colors, a score change, a menu or a scene cut alone does not establish victory.

events.label: Boss defeated
events.description: Explicit boss-defeated text is visible, or a continuous sequence clearly shows a boss encounter ending in the player's victory. This is a suggestion for the operator to confirm. A hidden health bar, loading, a menu or a camera cut alone is not evidence.
